editorial.blurb: Fresh, made-to-order sushi with an excellent all-you-can-eat menu that keeps regulars coming back for the quality and value.
editorial.insiderTip: Go for the all-you-can-eat option at around $33 — order the Hamachi Kama, Pork Belly Bun, and jalapeño bombs, and skip the cocktails in favor of simpler drinks.
